paths.mechanism: Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR to modulate anemia (phenotype) pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR to modulate chronic kidney disease pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → anemia (phenotype) → G6PD to modulate anemia pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → anemia (phenotype) → SPTB to modulate anemia pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → anemia (phenotype) → GATA1 to modulate anemia pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → PKD1 to modulate stage 5 chronic kidney disease pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → PKD1 to modulate kidney failure pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → PKD1 to modulate renal dialysis pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → PKD2 to modulate kidney failure pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → FERRIC CITRATE ANHYDROUS to modulate renal dialysis pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → UMOD to modulate kidney failure pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → TPPP to modulate kidney failure pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → PDILT to modulate secondary hyperparathyroidism pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → CALCIFEDIOL to modulate secondary hyperparathyroidism pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → VELCALCETIDE to modulate secondary hyperparathyroidism pathology.
Epoetin alfa (Epogen) engages EPOR → chronic kidney disease → SEVELAMER HYDROCHLORIDE to modulate renal dialysis pathology.
